source_text: In infants, the foreskin's immature development increases UTI vulnerability due to poor hygiene access, with meta-analyses of observational studies showing circumcision reduces UTI risk by approximately 90%, from a baseline of 1% in uncircumcised boys to 0.09%, yielding a number needed to treat of 111 to prevent one UTI.
